reviewed_implementation.loading: Original 394 F16 learned tensors/435064835 elements explicitly loaded as CPU FP32. Every learned source value compared to exact FP32 cast; one original I64 position buffer separately compared. Empty missing/unexpected/mismatched/error loading lists; active learned pooler/classifier preserved, no random head, no quantization.
